messages:
Zoe (Marketing): Quick sync: need a compact battlecard + 3 SDR hooks for the benchmark launch and webinar. Focus: cost delta, latency wins, migration offer. 15m?

Alex (Growth): Short and testable. Two headline variants: A) 'Cut inference spend with no code change' B) 'Keep SLAs, lower model costs' - we'll A/B test for demo signups.

Mina (Product): Bench soundbites to use: RAG workload: 28% lower per-token cost; p95 220ms vs 320ms baseline. Chat workload: 18% lower; p95 90ms vs 140ms. Use those as proof bullets and include legal check on numbers.

Carl (Sales): SDR hooks (one-liners):
- "Cut inference spend ~28% on RAG workloads  30m pilot"
- "Keep p95 latency under 250ms during spikes  quick demo"
- "Migration plan + usage credit in 2 weeks  pilot"

Zoe (Marketing): Draft battlecard front bullets: 
- Claim: 'Inference-first routing reduces real spend 20-35% vs managed endpoints'
- How: 'routing + KV/prefix caching + batching + automatic fallback to cheaper variants'
- Proof: 'Bench: RAG 28% lower cost; p95 220ms vs 320ms'
- CTA: '30m pilot + migration support'

Alex (Growth): Inbound routing rules: if lead message contains 'cost' or 'spend' -> Growth/pilot queue (tag econ); if contains 'latency' or 'p95' -> Solutions engineering; if 'private'/'on-prem' -> Enterprise AE. Auto-reply: "Thanks — which workload (chat, RAG, embeddings)?"

Mina (Product): Webinar plan: 8m demo (baseline endpoint -> Redwood routing -> fallback to quantized variant under spike), 7m slides (how pilot works), 5m Q&A. Rehearsal Friday 9am PT.

Carl (Sales): Rebut lines for SDRs (short):
1) "Why not CloudX?" -> 'Cloud endpoints obscure unit economics; we expose levers to trade cost vs latency.'
2) "Is this just quantization?" -> 'Quantization helps, but our platform combines quantization, batching, caching, and routing to preserve quality.'
3) "Were invested in VendorY" -> 'We offer a minimal-risk pilot and migration plan; many customers test delta in 2 weeks.'

Zoe (Marketing): Timeline: today: finalize battlecard + SDR templates; tomorrow: legal signoff on claims; Fri: rehearsal + publish webinar invite. Posting draft PDF to #docs when ready. :rocket:
